description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the launcher activity for an app demonstrating drag-and-drop or drop target functionality. It manages fragment transactions, options menu, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends SampleActivityBase, managing UI components, menu options, and logging for the sample app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and adds DropTargetFragment if no saved instance exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu items, toggling log visibility and updating menu item title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers, filters, and fragments for log display.
